scope: Embedded base RGB pixel identity, draw occurrence counts, full image placement geometry, and review renders. Not RTL or visual acceptance.
limitations: Image pixel equality is not proof of final page appearance.
Internal clipping paths, occlusion, transparency composition and page readability require actual visual inspection.
Technical page references come from supplied QA metadata; stale metadata is explicitly reported.
No PDF or source PNG is modified. Outputs are new review images and records.
